# @ibnlanre/portal

> Stores you declare, composed into trees, typed exactly as you wrote them.

Three constructors, each declaring a kind: `primitive(initial)` is one whole
value, `composite(shape)` is a tree of named branches (each a store), and
`collection(make)` makes branches by string key on first use (`String(id)` for numeric ids). Nothing inspects a value
to guess its kind.

## Core

```ts
import { collection, composite, primitive } from "@ibnlanre/portal";

const count = primitive(0);
const picked = primitive<null | string>(null);

const app = composite({
  user: composite({ name: "Taylor" }),
  theme: primitive<"dark" | "light">("light"),
  add() {
    count.$set((n) => n + 1);
  },
});

const drafts = collection((id: string) =>
  composite({ lines: primitive<string[]>([]) })
);
drafts("acme").lines.$set(["a"]);
```

Members of a composite shape: a store becomes that branch, a function stays a
method, anything else (including a plain object) becomes a leaf made with
`primitive`. Branch an object with `composite({ ... })`.

Every store has `$get`, `$use`, `$set`, `$subscribe`, `$reset`, `$dispose` and
`$onDispose`. `$set` on a primitive swaps the whole value. `$set` on a composite
writes each listed branch by that branch's own rule and leaves the others
alone; replace everything with `$reset()` then `$set(value)`.
Reads return your own values with your own types; do not mutate them.

## Batching

`batch(fn)` runs several writes as one outermost write: subscribers are called at
most once, after `fn` returns; nested calls join the outer one. Replace
everything with `batch(() => { store.$reset(); store.$set(value); })`.

## React

`store.$use()` returns `[value, setter]`; `store.$use(select, deps?)` selects.
Also `contextStore`, `useAsync`, `useSync`, `useVersion`.

## Persistence

```ts
import { localAdapter, persist } from "@ibnlanre/portal";

const adapter = localAdapter<State>("key", { version: 1, migrate, validate });
const persistor = persist(store, adapter, { skipHydration: true, });
await persistor.hydrate();
```

Adapters: `localAdapter`, `sessionAdapter`,
`cookieAdapter`, `customAdapter`,
`asyncAdapter`, each `(key, options?)`. For a collection,
`persist(collection, (key) => adapter)`. `asyncAdapter` takes
`watch: true` to follow other tabs of the origin, or `watch: fn`; `customAdapter`
takes `watch: fn` for your own source. The others take no `watch`.

## Cookies

`cookieStorage` reads, writes and signs cookies directly.
